lines.text: Welcome to the DeusEdix training. I am Dr. Elias Hale; I watch the rooms from behind the glass, up on your left.
Everything here was built in the editor a few minutes ago, on your own machine. Walk through the rooms and see what you made.
Room one. The crate you moved, and the one you placed on the green plate. Every object of the game is one click away in the palette.
Room two. Use the button. The door opens because you told it to: when JC uses the button, open the door. No tags, no events, no code.
Room three. The trooper greets you with the gesture you picked in his properties. My colleagues behind the glass have theirs too.
Room four. Talk to my colleague: she says what you wrote for her in the Story panel.
Last room, the library. The books hold the tips that did not fit in a lesson. That is the training. Good work.
